# Mercado Ventures

> Mercado Ventures Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based enterprise group working across business development, marine engineering, specialist maritime services, connected technology and the Casa Mercado lifestyle brand.

Canonical website: https://mercado.sg/

## Selected businesses and development initiatives

- [UX Marine](https://uxmarine.com/): Marine product and vessel development, including the Noordic range.
- [Boat Sparky](https://boatsparky.sg/): Marine electrical engineering, energy systems and systems integration.
- [UX Habitat](https://uxhabitat.com/): A marine group spanning vessel development, onboard engineering and specialist services. Polska Marine sits within this umbrella, providing vessel registration and maritime administration. Website: https://uxhabitat.com/.
- [Neptune Tech](https://neptunetech.org/): Initiatives exploring marine communications, remote monitoring and connected infrastructure.

- [Casa Mercado](https://casamercado.club/): The House wardrobe, with clothing and accessories including printed shirts, crew essentials, hats, bags and canvas shoes. Website: https://casamercado.club/.

Corporate and commercial relationships vary. This list does not imply that every business is a subsidiary. The website is the source of the descriptions; it provides no investment-performance or assets-under-management claims.
